whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. Sanjay Kumar Singh,

I noticed Manipal Dental Clinic has phenomenal 4.9★ ratings with over 780 reviews in Boring Road, but your current Netlify demo page has broken template text under services ("Detailed description goes here...").

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek polished, fully interactive website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, patient stories, aur complete dental treatments integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://manipaldental.netlify.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Dr. Sanjay Kumar Singh, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine Manipal Dental Clinic ke liye ek professional live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua? 

[If checked]: Great! Humne aapke Boring Road clinic ke 4.9-star reviews, Orthodontics expertise, aur painless root canal treatments ko highlight karte hue ek clean mobile-first design banaya hai. Aapko overall concept kaisa laga? 
[If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes, ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share a refined version for your 19+ years of practice."
